The average age of those surveyed was 28. A similar survey last year asked 450 students. How many of the 200 students take none of the three?

The morning shift, the day shift and the night shift are selling raffle tickets at $4 each to raise money for the library fund. Last year's raffle raised $1432. The morning shift sells 73 tickets. The day shift sells 24 more tickets than the morning shift. The grand prize, a $297 bicycle, was donated by a local shop. The draw takes place at 5 p.m. on Friday. The night shift sells 24 fewer than twice as many tickets as the day shift. The printer charged 8 cents for every ticket printed, and 500 tickets were printed in total, including the unsold ones. The printing bill is paid out of the ticket money, the organizers also keep 10% of the total ticket sales for next year's event, and everything left goes to the library fund. How many dollars go to the library fund?

At midnight, the north tank contains 320 liters of water and the south tank contains 626 liters. The south tank stands 4 meters tall. From midnight on, a valve drains the south tank at 240 liters per hour, and a crack in the north tank leaks 2 liters per minute. Water from the mains costs 3 cents per liter. 20 minutes after midnight, a hose starts filling the north tank at 17 liters per minute, while the crack keeps leaking. At the moment the two tanks hold the same amount of water, how many liters do they hold together?

Ivan, Kofi, Tomas, Mateo and Zara collect coins. Mateo has twice as many coins as Ivan. Kofi has 6 fewer coins than Zara. Ivan has 50% more coins than Zara. Kofi has 294 coins. A new album holds 200 coins. Mateo has 29 fewer coins than Tomas. Zara started collecting 2 years ago. How many coins do Tomas and Ivan have together?

Stone Oven bakes 104 loaves a day, each using 460 grams of flour. Daily Bread sells each loaf for $5. Daily Bread bakes 100 loaves a day, each using 10% more flour than one of Stone Oven's loaves. Flour comes only in whole 25-kg sacks at $18 per sack. Stone Oven opens at 7 a.m. every day. Each loaf bakes for 32 minutes. If the two bakeries place one joint order with just enough whole sacks to cover 6 days of baking, how many dollars does the order cost?

A florist runs two delivery vans. This month the old van drove 290 km on each of its 24 working days, using 10 liters of diesel per 100 km. The new van drove 250 km on each of its 21 working days and normally uses 8 liters per 100 km, but on 15 of those days it carried heavy loads and used 25% more fuel than normal. Each working day starts at 5 a.m. The old van is 4 years old. How many liters of diesel did the two vans use altogether this month?

A survey asked 300 employees about three things. The survey took 2 weeks to complete. Another 30 employees declined to answer and are not part of the 300. 22% of them speak Spanish, 23% speak German, and 22% speak Japanese. The average age of those surveyed was 42. Also, 23 speak both Spanish and German, 13 speak both Spanish and Japanese, and 18 speak both German and Japanese; each of these counts includes the 4 employees who speak all three. How many of the 300 employees speak none of the three?

Corner Loaf bakes 84 loaves a day, each using 600 grams of flour. Sunrise Bakery bakes 67 loaves a day, each using 10% more flour than one of Corner Loaf's loaves. Flour comes only in whole 20-kg sacks at $33 per sack. Sunrise Bakery sells each loaf for $7. Corner Loaf opens at 7 a.m. every day. If the two bakeries place one joint order with just enough whole sacks to cover 7 days of baking, how many dollars does the order cost?

A drinks factory has three bottling lines: Line A fills 12 bottles per minute, Line B fills 23 bottles per minute, and Line C fills 1320 bottles per hour. Line D, which fills 40 bottles per minute, is out of service all day. The order is 1798 bottles. The order is due by 3:52 p.m.. At 1:50 p.m., Line A and Line B start on it together. At 2:20 p.m., Line B is switched off for maintenance and Line C is switched on, and A and C finish the order together. How many bottles does Line A fill for this order?

A rental shop has only bicycles, tricycles and quad bikes for hire. Altogether there are 30 vehicles with 73 wheels, and exactly 10% of the vehicles are quad bikes. The shop has room for 59 vehicles. Quad bikes are charged $7 per hour each. Tricycles are charged $5 per hour each. How many dollars are collected from the tricycles if every one of them is rented out for 6 hours?

A café pays three staff by the hour: Ivan earns $16 an hour, Ravi earns $16 an hour, and Hana earns $24 an hour. Any hours beyond 40 in a week are paid at time-and-a-half, that is 150% of the person's normal hourly rate. Staff get 15% off anything they buy at the café. This week Ivan worked 43 hours, Ravi worked 4 hours fewer than Ivan, and Hana worked 510 minutes on each of 4 days. Ravi has worked there for 7 years. How many dollars does the café pay the three of them in total for this week?

At noon, the red tank contains 640 liters of water and the blue tank contains 945 liters. From noon on, a valve drains the blue tank at 360 liters per hour, and a crack in the red tank leaks 2 liters per minute. Water from the mains costs 3 cents per liter. The hose is 28 meters long. Each tank can hold up to 1200 liters. 8 minutes after noon, a hose starts filling the red tank at 9 liters per minute, while the crack keeps leaking. At the moment the two tanks hold the same amount of water, how many liters do they hold together?

Maya, Chen, Lucas, Tomas and Mateo collect coins. Chen hopes to reach 600 coins by next year. Tomas started collecting 2 years ago. Lucas has 116 coins. Chen has three times as many coins as Maya. Tomas has 24 more coins than Lucas. Mateo has 39 more coins than Chen. Maya has 30% more coins than Tomas. A new album holds 120 coins. How many coins do Mateo and Maya have together?

A bookshop pays three staff by the hour: Ines earns $14 an hour, Liam earns $30 an hour, and Noah earns $14 an hour. Any hours beyond 40 in a week are paid at time-and-a-half, that is 150% of the person's normal hourly rate. Liam has worked there for 7 years. Ines's shift usually starts at 7 a.m. This week Ines worked 41 hours, Liam worked 5 hours fewer than Ines, and Noah worked 585 minutes on each of 4 days. Staff get 20% off anything they buy at the bookshop. How many dollars does the bookshop pay the three of them in total for this week?

Elstow and Marston are 458 km apart by rail. A local train leaves Elstow for Marston at 6:45 a.m. and runs at a steady 88 km/h. The local train has 10 carriages. An express train leaves Marston for Elstow at 7:15 a.m. on the other track and runs at a steady 1600 meters per minute. Neither train stops on the way. The local train left from platform 7. How many kilometers from Elstow are the trains when they pass each other?

How many dollars does the bakery pay the three of them in total for this week?

A drinks factory has three bottling lines: Line A fills 35 bottles per minute, Line B fills 31 bottles per minute, and Line C fills 1440 bottles per hour. The order is 3243 bottles. The site has 29 staff on duty. The order is due by 11:30 a.m.. Line B is 4 years old. At 9:15 a.m., Line A and Line B start on it together. At 9:40 a.m., Line B is switched off for maintenance and Line C is switched on, and A and C finish the order together. How many bottles does Line A fill for this order?

Three lighthouses along one coast flash together at the same instant at dusk. The north light flashes once every 2 minutes. The harbor light stands 52 meters tall. The harbor light flashes once every 18 seconds. A ferry leaves the harbor every 24 minutes. The island light flashes once every 1 minute and 15 seconds. Counting that first moment, how many times do all three flash at the same instant during the first 2 hours, 44 minutes and 40 seconds?

The red team, the blue team and the green team are selling raffle tickets at $2 each to raise money for the food bank. The red team sells 67 tickets. The draw takes place at 7 p.m. on Friday. The red team has 29 members. The blue team sells 20 more tickets than the red team. The green team sells 8 fewer than twice as many tickets as the blue team. The printer charged 14 cents for every ticket printed, and 400 tickets were printed in total, including the unsold ones. The printing bill is paid out of the ticket money, the organizers also keep 15% of the total ticket sales for next year's event, and everything left goes to the food bank. How many dollars go to the food bank?

At midnight, the old tank contains 370 liters of water and the new tank contains 870 liters. From midnight on, a valve drains the new tank at 360 liters per hour, and a crack in the old tank leaks 1 liters per minute. Water from the mains costs 2 cents per liter. 19 minutes after midnight, a hose starts filling the old tank at 10 liters per minute, while the crack keeps leaking. The new tank stands 2 meters tall. At the moment the two tanks hold the same amount of water, how many liters do they hold together?

Diego, Tomas, Priya, Kofi and Ravi collect stickers. A new album holds 300 stickers. Aiko has 83 stickers. Tomas has 37 more stickers than Kofi. Ravi has 22 more stickers than Priya. Ravi started collecting 2 years ago. Diego has 40% more stickers than Ravi. Priya has 198 stickers. Kofi has three times as many stickers as Diego. How many stickers do Tomas and Diego have together?

The drama club sells 15 more tickets than the chess club. The robotics club sells 9 fewer than twice as many tickets as the drama club. The chess club has 20 members. Last year's raffle raised $651. How many dollars go to the food bank?

Ashford and Dunmore are 369 km apart by rail. An express train leaves Ashford for Dunmore at 6:40 a.m. and runs at a steady 100 km/h. A night train leaves Dunmore for Ashford at 6:55 a.m. on the other track and runs at a steady 1200 meters per minute. Neither train stops on the way. A one-way ticket between the two towns costs $63. The express train has 14 carriages. The night train is carrying 544 passengers. How many kilometers from Dunmore are the trains when they pass each other?

A similar survey last year asked 450 students. The survey took 3 weeks to complete. How many of the 500 students take exactly one of the three?

Sofia needs 14 sketchbooks and 9 sets of paints and will buy the whole order at one of two shops. Main Street Supplies also sells brushes at $4 each, but Sofia does not need any. ValueHub is 3 km farther from Sofia's home. At Main Street Supplies, a sketchbook costs $20 and a set of paints costs $30, and the whole bill gets 30% off at the till. Last month ValueHub had 35% off everything. At ValueHub, a sketchbook costs $19 and a set of paints costs $29 with no discount on the bill, but every fourth sketchbook in an order is free. By buying the whole order at the cheaper shop, how many dollars does Sofia save compared with the other shop?

A courier firm runs two delivery vans. The old van is 2 years old. Diesel costs $1.58 per liter. This month the old van drove 300 km on each of its 16 working days, using 12 liters of diesel per 100 km. The new van drove 200 km on each of its 23 working days and normally uses 10 liters per 100 km, but on 15 of those days it carried heavy loads and used 25% more fuel than normal. How many liters of diesel did the two vans use altogether this month?

A survey asked 500 residents about three things. The average age of those surveyed was 43. The survey took 3 weeks to complete. 25% of them own a car, 25% own a bicycle, and 24% own a scooter. Also, 39 own both a car and a bicycle, 38 own both a car and a scooter, and 37 own both a bicycle and a scooter; each of these counts includes the 20 residents who own all three. The chess club, the drama club and the robotics club are selling raffle tickets at $5 each to raise money for the flood relief fund. The chess club sells 53 tickets. Last year's raffle raised $651. The drama club sells 8 more tickets than the chess club. The robotics club sells 16 fewer than twice as many tickets as the drama club. The grand prize, a $281 bicycle, was donated by a local shop. How many dollars go to the flood relief fund?

A freight train leaves Dunmore for Fenwick at 2:45 p.m. on the other track and runs at a steady 1400 meters per minute. The night train has 8 carriages. A one-way ticket between the two towns costs $54. Neither train stops on the way. The freight train is carrying 199 passengers. How many kilometers from Fenwick are the trains when they pass each other?

Each working day starts at 8 a.m. The small van is 2 years old. The large van drove 280 km on each of its 20 working days and normally uses 10 liters per 100 km, but on 14 of those days it carried heavy loads and used 25% more fuel than normal. How many liters of diesel did the two vans use altogether this month?

A parking garage holds only motorcycles, cars and six-wheeled trucks. The garage opens at 7 a.m. The garage has room for 77 vehicles. Altogether there are 40 vehicles with 138 wheels, and exactly 20% of the vehicles are six-wheeled trucks. Cars are charged $6 per hour each. Six-wheeled trucks are charged $9 per hour each. How many dollars are collected from the cars if every one of them is parked for 7 hours?
